candidates.change_summary: Change the requirement on msg.value from exactly 10 ether to at least 10 ether, altering when fallback() proceeds and thus affecting pastBlockTime updates.
Change the update to pastBlockTime to set it to block.timestamp (remove +1), so the stored time after fallback differs by one second.
Remove the require that block.timestamp must be greater than pastBlockTime, allowing fallback to update pastBlockTime even when timestamp is not greater.
Change the conditional that pays out to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when balance is transferred and thus observable state.
Insert an additional increment of pastBlockTime (add 1 more second) after the original assignment, changing the final stored value.
